items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: we’re going to the Palace Verdi Symphony tonight to hear some Mendelssohn.

ctx.x: Great. Well I hope the rest of your day is good and you get some body surfing in.

Oh I’m sure it will be and we’re going to the Palace Verdi Symphony tonight to hear some Mendelssohn. And they’re having an interesting thing, I mean they’re inviting all the people who are quote friends of the symphony to kind of support the symphony, to have dinner with the musicians. I said I really need that, dinner with the musicians.
Well see how long it takes the strings to hit the downbeat.
